hero.title: Communicate Your Business
hero.title_full: Ready-to-run systems for growing Middle East businesses
hero.description: WEBKMT installs the website, customer-response, selling and operating systems your business needs, then helps you run them in Arabic and English.
hero.system_title: From first message to daily operations
hero.system_note: Start with the bottleneck costing you enquiries, sales or staff time. Connect the next system when the first is working.
hero.route1_desc: A clear website or store turns attention into an enquiry or order.
hero.route2_desc: WEBKMT Chat acknowledges and answers from approved business information.
hero.route3_desc: Need, timing and contact details are captured for human follow-up.
hero.route4_desc: Orders, stock, invoices and customers move into one operating system.

services.title: How We Help You Communicate
services.description: Strategic solutions to amplify your business voice and automate your success

web_development.title: Digital Presence Solutions
web_development.description: Professional websites and web applications that communicate your brand effectively to your target audience
web_development.detailed_description: Transform how your business communicates online with custom-built platforms that drive engagement and conversions. Our solutions increase brand visibility and streamline customer interactions, delivering measurable business growth.

mobile_apps.title: Mobile Communication Platforms
mobile_apps.description: Connect with your customers anywhere through powerful mobile applications that enhance business communication
mobile_apps.detailed_description: Extend your business communication reach with custom mobile applications. Our solutions help you stay connected with customers, streamline operations, and provide exceptional service experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

marketing_automation.title: Business Communication Automation
marketing_automation.description: Intelligent workflows that help your business communicate consistently and efficiently with customers
marketing_automation.detailed_description: Streamline how your business communicates with customers through smart automation. Our systems handle lead nurturing, customer onboarding, and retention campaigns, allowing your team to focus on growth while maintaining personal touch.

seo_optimization.title: Search Communication Optimization
seo_optimization.description: Help your business communicate effectively with potential customers through strategic search optimization
seo_optimization.detailed_description: Ensure your business communicates its value when customers search online. Our data-driven approach improves your visibility, helping the right customers find and choose your services over competitors.

brand_strategy.title: Brand Communication Strategy
brand_strategy.description: Develop a compelling brand voice and visual identity that communicates your business values effectively
brand_strategy.detailed_description: Help your business communicate its unique value proposition through strategic branding. We analyze your market position and craft messaging that resonates with your audience, ensuring consistent communication across all touchpoints.

portfolio.title: Inspect the products
portfolio.description: Client identities stay confidential. Evaluate WEBKMT through our own products, template gallery, free tools and business profile. Items labelled pilot or scoped are not presented as finished client case studies.

process.title: How we work
process.description: A clear path from first conversation to a running system. Timelines are confirmed in the official quote after scope and client inputs are known.

discovery.title: Discover
discovery.description: We identify the bottleneck, current tools, users and success criteria.

design.title: Scope & official quote
design.description: We recommend the smallest suitable system and separate inclusions, exclusions and third-party costs.

development.title: Configure or build
development.description: We install, brand and configure content, data, workflows and integrations in the agreed scope.

testing.title: Review & train
testing.description: We test realistic cases with the people who will use the system and correct the agreed items.

launch.title: Launch & care
launch.description: We go live, monitor first use and maintain or improve the system under the selected programme.

templates_page.title: Pick a design. Choose how much we do.
templates_page.subtitle: Every design uses the same three plans: buy the files, have us customize the files, or choose Ultimate for content, hosting and a maintained first year.
templates_page.step1_d: Choose the design closest to your business. Ask us if you need a guided walkthrough.
templates_page.step2_d: Plan 1 is files only. Plans 2–3 are confirmed on a short WhatsApp or Google Meet call.
templates_page.step3_d: Plan 1 files arrive within two days after payment. Customized and Ultimate timelines are confirmed in your quote.
templates_page.how_title: Payment and ownership, in plain terms
templates_page.how_1_d: Plan 1 can be ordered directly. For customization or Ultimate, we confirm pages, content and features before quoting.
templates_page.how_2_d: Current methods are IBAN, Western Union or crypto. A human sends payment details after the official quote is agreed.
templates_page.how_3_d: After full payment, you own the purchased template and may modify or resell it. Included fonts and libraries keep their own licences.
templates_page.cta_desc: Tell us your business type and we will suggest the closest current design or scope a custom direction.
templates_page.plan1_desc: Template code files, delivered within two days after payment.
templates_page.plan2_desc: We adapt the design and structure to your business before delivering the files.
templates_page.plan3_desc: Customization, content writing, hosting, annual maintenance and minor edits.

foundations.title: Yours to keep
foundations.description: Every WEBKMT system is installed under your own accounts and handed over with the keys, so you are buying an operating asset rather than another blank software account.
foundations.f1_desc: Repeatable ERP, commerce, website and automation systems that can be tailored per client.
foundations.f2_desc: Saudi/Gulf-friendly customer language, RTL-aware interfaces and English for partners and staff.
foundations.f3_desc: AI answers are grounded in the services, prices and policies the business approves, with human escalation.
foundations.f4_desc: Your business data remains yours. Hosting, backup and support boundaries are written into each programme.

poster.hero_sentence: Ready-to-run websites, WhatsApp AI, online store, ERP and automation for Saudi and Gulf businesses. Published prices, in Arabic and English.
poster.features_sub: Five systems, one route. Start where it hurts, connect the next when the first is working.
poster.sentence_own: You own what you pay for.
poster.sentence_answer: Answered in seconds. Even at midnight.
poster.slips_p1: Not a login to someone else's platform. Documents, messages and records with your name on them.
poster.slips_p2: Six samples of the output, as it lands.
poster.slip1_c: Scope, timeline and inclusions in writing, before work begins.
poster.slip2_a: Plans start at USD 150 for the template files. Customized files are USD 300–799. Want the details here, or a short call?
poster.slip3_c: Delivery details are in your account.
poster.slip4_c: Issued from your own system, in Arabic and English.
poster.step1_line: First, tell us where it hurts.
poster.step1_text: A 30-minute call. We find the bottleneck costing you enquiries, sales or staff time.
poster.step2_text: Scope, timeline, inclusions and exclusions on paper. No surprises later.
poster.step3_text: Your system is installed from a maintained golden build, branded and set up around your content and data.
poster.step4_line: Your team learns on real cases.
poster.step4_text: We test realistic work with the people who will use it, and correct the setup with them.
poster.step5_text: We go live, watch first use, and keep it updated, backed up and answered for under care.
poster.about_overlay: Leave any time and take your files, data and exports with you. That is written into every program, not added as a favour.
poster.about_map: Türkiye to the Gulf, one conversation.
poster.proof_note: Client names stay confidential, for legal reasons. Judge us by the products above instead.
poster.p_web_n: Files within 2 days of payment. Yours 100% after full payment.
poster.p_chat_n: Pilot deployments. 5,000 messages classified and 3,000 AI answers a month.
poster.p_store_n: Payments, shipping and add-ons are scoped in your quote.
poster.prices_fine: Entry prices in USD. Your official written quote itemises scope, taxes and third-party fees before work begins.
poster.insights_desc: Practical guides and deep dives on software engineering, AI tooling, and business automation
poster.book_sentence: Tell us where the route breaks. Thirty minutes ends with a written quote.
